plan.title: Substrate Phase 1: delivery is a confirmed turn; no monitor mail
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

narratives.Problem: Automatic message delivery to a running Claude Code agent reports delivered:true without any turn appearing in the transcript. The PAN-3015 monitor-mail tier sits ahead of the PTY supervisor whenever a monitor heartbeat is live, so it became the everyday path for pipeline feedback and pan tell; on PAN-3836 the UAT feedback was reported delivered and the agent never took a turn. A failed UAT does not count as owed rework, pan tell prints Message sent unconditionally, and the deacon nudges working agents through raw sendKeys because idle is read from the mirror label instead of work activity. Four patrols exist only to repair unconfirmed deliveries.
narratives.Proposal: Make messageAgent confirm the turn against the transcript (the primitive resumeAgent already uses), return delivered:false with a reason otherwise, delete the monitor-mail tier and the eaten-message watcher, count a failed UAT as owed rework, make pan tell exit with the truth, derive idle from work activity and route nudges through messageAgent, write a delivery no-loss audit, then delete the four delivery-recovery patrols and document the contract.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the paused, suspended or stopped delivery gates; they keep returning delivered:false with the gate reason.
- No removal of the pan monitor or pan inbox commands (manual transport stays).
- No change to non-Claude harness delivery beyond the confirmed:false field.
- No patrol deletions from later phases.

metadata.sizeJustification: Phase of epic PAN-3845; the work items are the PRD work items and cannot be split without losing the audit-before-delete ordering. Subsystem count is inflated by single docs files (each counts as its own subsystem).

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W1 in drafts/pan-3846.md. In messaging.ts add confirmed?: boolean to MessageDeliveryOutcome and replace the running-agent branch (from const transcriptSessionId at line 625 through the final return) with the After block in W1 step 3: unkeyed Claude Code deliveries call the confirming primitive and return delivered:false, confirmed:false with a NOT confirmed lifecycle line when no turn appears; keyed deliveries and non-Claude harnesses keep deliverWithOptionalKey with confirmed:false. When agentState.deliveryMethod is supervisor or supervisorEnabled is true pass deliveryMethod supervisor explicitly and never fall back to tmux paste (resume.ts:576-582 states why). Delete eaten-message-watcher.ts, its test, and its import. Checkpoint: if deliverWithOptionalKey already confirms keyed messages, set confirmed from its result.
